label: TP
reason: User input flows directly into the SQL query via Base64 decode/encode roundtrip which preserves content, then gets concatenated into the query string used in JDBC.execute(). The ESAPI encoder only protects the result set output, not the SQL itself. The SQL query becomes part of the database command, enabling SQL injection.

evidence.note: User param undergoes Base64 encode/decode preserving content, then concatenated into SQL query executed against database
